The '''Doomsled''' was a type of [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] [[Transport/Legends|transport]] that was made for and utilized by the [[Galactic Alliance Guard]] to haul [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] into custody in a very public manner. [[Tahiri Veila]], along with a contingent of GAG [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]], transported [[Ben Skywalker]] and [[Lon Shevu]] from [[Monument Plaza/Legends|Monument Plaza]] to a [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] in one of these vehicles.<ref name="Invincible" />
